parameters.name: BusinessStatus
parameters.description:
The business status of the migration job. Valid values:

*   Preparing: The migration is being prepared.
*   Syncing: Data is being synchronized.
*   Processing: The migration is in progress.
*   Cleaning: Intermediate resources are being released.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The IDs of the destination Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances.

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description: The IDs of the migration jobs. You can specify a maximum of 50 IDs.

parameters.name: JobType
parameters.description:
The type of the migration job. Valid values:

*   0: server migration.
*   1: operating system migration.
*   2: cross-zone migration.
*   3: agentless migration for a VMware VM.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the migration job.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud region to which you want to migrate the source server.

For example, if you want to migrate a source server to the China (Hangzhou) region, set this parameter to `cn-hangzhou`. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the latest regions.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: SourceId
parameters.description: The IDs of the source servers. You can specify a maximum of 50 IDs.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the migration job. Valid values:

*   Ready: The migration job is not started.
*   Running: The migration job is running.
*   Stopped: The migration job is paused.
*   InError: An error occurs in the migration job.
*   Finished: The migration job is complete.
*   Waiting: The migration job is waiting to run.
*   Expired: The migration job has expired.
*   Deleting: The migration job is being deleted.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The information about tags that are attached to the SMC resource.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun smc describe-replication-jobs --name testMigrationTaskName --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --status Ready --business-status Preparing --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --source-id s-bp1bjhkwk2j5hlbn0000 --job-id j-bp1h3d33mekxwu0n0000 --job-type 0 --instance-id i-bp1f1dvfto1sigz50000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmw3ty5y70000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun smc DescribeReplicationJobs --region cn-hangzhou --Status Ready --Tag.1.Key TestKey --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmw3ty5y70000' --JobId.1 'j-bp1h3d33mekxwu0n0000' --BusinessStatus Preparing --Name testMigrationTaskName --JobType 0 --SourceId.1 's-bp1bjhkwk2j5hlbn0000' --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value TestValue --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceId.1 'i-bp1f1dvfto1sigz50000'
